actions.action: Move the plant to the sunniest spot or outdoors in full sun, acclimating it gradually over about a week
Slide the plant out of its pot and check the roots and soil moisture
Trim any rotten roots if found
Repot into a gritty mix (cactus mix plus perlite or sand) in a pot slightly bigger than the root ball
Make sure the plant is in a nursery pot with drainage holes and no water pools in the cachepot
Water thoroughly, then let the soil dry well before watering again
Prune dead and yellow growth and cut leggy stems back by about a third
Wear gloves and long sleeves when pruning or repotting

reason: The answer blames low light and mentions underwatering only as one possibility, while its main advice (let the soil dry out more deeply, use a fast-draining gritty mix) pushes toward drier conditions, which would likely worsen dehydration and delay the needed extra watering.
